propositions: Plan review routes that return PASS must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default unless explicitly opted out with --no-sign (CLI) or sign=False (library)
Every mutating public plan-review entry point (CLI review-plan command and library review_plan function) must converge on the same sign-on-PASS default behavior through a shared finalization seam
Skipping signature must be explicit and visible at each boundary; BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and non-signable results must remain unsigned regardless of the sign parameter
Idempotent re-invocation with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it without additional LLM calls or duplicate signature events
A PASS with signature-persistence failure must return a retryable disposition and identify sign-review as the recovery path
